trans-unit.source: Failed to resolve SDK '{0}'. A package was successfully restored but the package could not be located.
trans-unit.target: SDK '{0}' を解決できませんでした。パッケージは正常に復元されましたが、そのパッケージが見つかりませんでした。
trans-unit.note: {0} is the name of an MSBuild project SDK.

trans-unit.source: Downloading MSBuild project SDK package "{0}" version "{1}"...
trans-unit.target: Downloading MSBuild project SDK package "{0}" version "{1}"...
trans-unit.note: {0} is the name of the SDK, {1} is the version

trans-unit.source: The NuGetSdkResolver did not resolve this SDK because it was disabled by the MSBUILDDISABLENUGETSDKRESOLVER environment variable.
trans-unit.target: NuGetSdkResolver は、MSBUILDDISABLENUGETSDKRESOLVER 環境変数によって無効になっているため、この SDK を解決できませんでした。
NuGet 設定を読み込めませんでした。{0}

trans-unit.source: The NuGetSdkResolver did not resolve this SDK because there was no version specified in the project or global.json.
trans-unit.target: プロジェクトまたは global.json でバージョンが指定されていなかったため、NuGetSdkResolver でこの SDK を解決できませんでした。

trans-unit.source: The NuGet-based MSBuild project SDK resolver did not resolve the SDK "{0}" because there was no version specified in the project or global.json.
trans-unit.target: The NuGet-based MSBuild project SDK resolver did not resolve the SDK "{0}" because there was no version specified in the project or global.json.
trans-unit.note: {0} is the user specified SDK name.

trans-unit.source: The NuGet-based MSBuild project SDK resolver did not resolve the SDK "{0}" because there was no version specified in the project or the file "{1}".
trans-unit.target: The NuGet-based MSBuild project SDK resolver did not resolve the SDK "{0}" because there was no version specified in the project or the file "{1}".
trans-unit.note: {0} is the user specified SDK name and {1} is the full path to a global.json file.

trans-unit.source: Unhandled exception in NuGet-based MSBuild project SDK resolver.
trans-unit.target: Unhandled exception in NuGet-based MSBuild project SDK resolver.

trans-unit.source: Failed to determine path to global.json from path "{0}". {1}
trans-unit.target: パス "{0}" から global.json へのパスを決定できませんでした。{1}
trans-unit.note: {0} is the path to the file used to start looking for global.json and {1} is the exception message that occurred.

trans-unit.target: "{0}" を解析できませんでした。{1}
trans-unit.note: {0} is the path to the global.json file that was attempted to be parsed and {1} is the exception message that occurred.

trans-unit.target: ファイル "{0}" を読み取れませんでした: {1}
trans-unit.note: {0} is the path to the global.json file that was attempted to be read and {1} is the exception message that occurred.
{0} is the nae of the SDK, {1} is the version

trans-unit.source: Failed to resolve SDK '{0}'. Package restore was successful but a package with the ID of "{1}" was not installed.
trans-unit.target: SDK '{0}' を解決できませんでした。パッケージの復元は成功しましたが、ID が "{1}" のパッケージはインストールされませんでした。
trans-unit.note: {0} is name of an MSBuild project SDK and {1} is package ID that was installed.

trans-unit.source: Successfully downloaded MSBuild project SDK package "{0}" version "{1}" to "{2}".
trans-unit.target: Successfully downloaded MSBuild project SDK package "{0}" version "{1}" to "{2}".
trans-unit.note: {0} is the name of the MSBuild project SDK, {1} is the version, and {2} is the path to where the package was downloaded to.

trans-unit.source: The NuGet-based MSBuild project SDK resolver did not resolve SDK "{0}" because the specified version "{1}" is not a valid NuGet version.
trans-unit.target: The NuGet-based MSBuild project SDK resolver did not resolve SDK "{0}" because the specified version "{1}" is not a valid NuGet version.
trans-unit.note: {0} is the user specified SDK name and {1} is the full path to a global.json file.
